title: Austin Strategic Planning & Litigation
summary:
*   Held a dedicated work session to discuss the city's long-term Strategic Planning initiatives.
*   Convened in executive session to confidentially discuss ongoing legal and litigation matters.

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the
absence of Councilmember Humphrey.
After a work session on Strategic Planning, the Mayor announced Council would enter into
executive session pursuant to Article 6252-17. Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to
discuss litigation matters. No official action of the City Council will be taken on any of
these matters unless such item is listed on the agenda. RECESS AND ADJOURNMENT Council
recessed its meeting at 5:57 p.m. and resumed its recessed meeting at 6:16 p.m.
